anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The ends of the ages have come.

choices.why: How the old command is to be taken now.

pass_a_gloss: and it being sought now by us whether it has been completed only in the time according to those, the deed having been filled, so that one must not otherwise according to another taking receive it into the completing times according to us, into which the ends of the ages have come down,
pass_b_english: Now we ask whether it was completed only in their time, the deed having been fulfilled, so that it need not be received in another sense for the times that complete things among us, into which the ends of the ages have come (1 Corinthians 10:11).
source_text: ἐπιζητουμένης δὲ νῦν ὑφ’ ἡμῶν εἰ μόνῳ χρόνῳ τῷ κατ’ ἐκείνους, πεπληρωμένου τοῦ πράγματος, τετέλεσται, ὡς μὴ δεῖν ἄλλως κατ’ ἄλλην ἐκδοχὴν δέξασθαι εἰς τοὺς καθ’ ἡμᾶς συμπληρωτικοὺς χρόνους, εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν,
